name: @zeta/society
description: Standalone TypeScript society algebra — AggregationRule (the k-of-n generator and its dominating endpoints), levels/obligations, and the CTM. TypeScript twin of src/Core/{AggregationRule,Levels,Society}.fs. Bun-native; no build step required. The manifest exists so NodeNext consumers (agentic-organization's TypeScript island) infer ESM for these files rather than CommonJS — same reason @zeta/id, @zeta/merkle, and @zeta/metric carry one.
author: Lucent Financial Group
